race.comment: PORTICO (4) tackled Listed company up at Eagle Farm before the break on the back of a strong maiden win. Strips fitter for two handy trials and gets Clark from the inside pillar. Bright return anticipated. COSMIC ORDER (11) bounced back to somewhere near her best form last time when chasing gamely into second over the Newy 900m burner. Represents a hot stable and gets a key booking in Lloyd. Should be very competitive. VAIN TEMPTRESS (7) impressed when successful on debut over this trip at Hawkesbury three-and-a-half weeks ago. Improvement to come and there's no reason she can't make it two on the bounce. PARTHENON (9) led all the way on debut at Gosford last month then tried to repeat the dose at Hawkesbury but came up just short. Fitter and will be looking to steal it from the front again.
